page.overview:
Who is Dayto?

One of 's worries is whether he should traverse . If there are other people up there, though, he believes he could sell to them. He is unsure if he should try to withstand the heat, since he will end up sweating either way.

During the night, struggles with whether or not he should sleep. Even then, he has difficulties choosing a spot to rest.

If saves from monsters encountered along the route, he initially has difficulty believing the danger is over. He's scared of monsters, even describing himself as drenched with sweat after seeing monsters. He will give the hero and as thanks. Along his journey, he encounters the by , which he runs from in fear.
